prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1094; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on a main road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. Traffic was moving slowly.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car in front of me slowed down, and I braked, but the vehicle behind me didn't stop in time. It hit the back of my car pretty hard.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up, and I felt my arm jerk forward against the steering wheel.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my wrist and said it was fractured. I've since been fitted with a cast.

Q: Have you had any other injuries, like to your neck or back?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches when I sit too long, but the wrist is the worst of it.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?

A: Briefly. He apologized and said he was looking at his phone for a second. A police officer came and took a report.

Q: Do you have any photos of the vehicles or the scene?

A: I took a few photos of my car's rear bumper and the other vehicle before it was towed.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still waiting to see a specialist, and I'm worried about missing work while my hand heals.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
